# internal/tasks property tests that dominate the package under -race (2273 s
# in default r3 before the split; CapRun ~573 s, MultiHandle ~130 s, Reservation
# >300 s under -race). They run in their own "Test shard (default tp)"
# (go test -run) and every other shard skips them (go test -skip), so each runs
# exactly once. One exact test name per line; '#' lines ignored.
# tasks-heavy-tests_test.sh checks the names exist, are unique repo-wide, and
# that -run plus -skip cover the package exactly once.
TestCapRunPropertyInvariants
TestReservationPropertyInvariants
